message.text: I need to identify the persistent entity types defined in the store package—things like User, Memo, Attachment, Reaction, Webhook, MemoShare, and Inbox—then check how many external packages depend on each one.
I'm identifying the core entity types in the system and then checking how many packages outside the store directory reference each one to understand the coupling and dependencies across the codebase.

args.command:
cd /bench/repo && for t in User Memo Attachment Reaction MemoRelation MemoShare Inbox IdentityProvider UserIdentity UserSetting InstanceSetting; do
  count=$(grep -rl "store\.$t\b" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "^./store/" | xargs -n1 dirname 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l)
  echo "$t: $count"
done

message.text:
h11.

**1st: `store.User`** (`store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store/`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`.

**2nd: `store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go:35`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside `store/`: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`.

For comparison, the next most-referenced entity types trailed well behind: `store.Attachment` (~4 packages: e.g. `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1`), `store.MemoRelation`/`store.MemoShare`/`store.Inbox` (~3 packages each), and `store.Reaction`/`store.UserIdentity` (~2 packages each), with `store.IdentityProvider`, `store.UserSetting`, and `store.InstanceSetting` each confined to essentially one consuming package.

Methodology: for each entity struct declared directly in the `store` package (`store/*.go`), I searched the whole repo for word-bounded references of the form `store.<Type>`, excluded matches inside `store/` itself, and counted the number of distinct package directories containing at least one such reference.
